edges: Alexander Henderson was born in Scotland.
Alexander Henderson emigrated to Canada in 1855.
Alexander Henderson emigrated to Canada with his wife Agnes Elder Robertson.
Alexander Henderson settled in Montreal after emigrating.
Alexander Henderson became a personal friend and colleague of William Notman.
Alexander Henderson and William Notman made a photographic excursion to Niagara Falls in 1860.
Alexander Henderson won first prizes in an exhibition held in New York in 1877.
Collections of Alexander Henderson's work are held at the McCord Museum of Canadian History.
Alexander Henderson's work won second prize at the world exhibition in Paris in 1878.
Alexander Henderson retired completely from photography in 1897.
After Alexander Henderson died in 1913, his huge collection of glass negatives was stored in the basement of his house.
Collections of Alexander Henderson's work are held at the National Archives of Canada.
